Comment: What proteinCAD needs to start and stop its own GPU, and nothing else.
Replace REGION, ACCOUNT_ID and INSTANCE_ID, then attach this to the IAM
user or role the app runs as. Naming the instance in the resource arn is
the part that matters: these credentials can then start and stop that one
box and no other, which is what makes them safe to put on a web server.
DescribeInstances and DescribeInstanceAttribute do not support
resource-level permissions in EC2 -- they are read-only and have to be
granted on *. The second is optional: without it proteinCAD simply skips
